headline: Crucial first down for Indianapolis
what_happened: On third down, which is the third of four tries the offense gets to move the ball, D.Jones threw a short pass to J.Downs for a gain that earned a first down.
who: D.Jones and J.Downs moved the ball for the Indianapolis offense.
why_it_matters: This is tough news for our Chiefs since it keeps the Indianapolis drive alive. It increases their chances of winning by 9 percentage points while the score remains tied.
